subject: Science
stem: Naphthalene balls (used to repel insects in cupboards) and solid carbon dioxide ('dry ice') both gradually disappear over time by turning directly into gas, without first melting into a liquid. This change of state is called:
explanation: Sublimation is the direct transition from solid to gas, skipping the liquid state entirely (as with naphthalene and dry ice) — evaporation instead requires a liquid-to-gas transition, and deposition is the reverse process (gas directly becoming solid).
